summary: [standards] The recipe form of check 2 was never run: the evidence binds the checker crate's 369 tests to `nextest --profile atip`, but `just test-atip` and the CI job `atip-check-tests` run `cargo test -p atip-check` (one process per binary, one thread per test). Run at HEAD here, that form FAILED twice on `atip_checkl2input_20_an_unlisted_write_never_decides_unsupported_and_leaves_the_batch_rows_unprovided` (`L2.input-normalise is not in data.checks`, tests/support/l2.rs:279; 31 of 32 in the binary, `cargo test` stops there so later binaries need --no-fail-fast; the other 17 binaries passed). The test passes alone, passes with `-- --test-threads=3` (32 passed) and under nextest, so it looks like the fixture's per-call time limit under load (host load average ~45), not a defect of the split; the crate is unchanged. Blast radius: the same code ran inside `offline` before, but the new job has never run on CI (the change is not pushed) and that job is now the only place the 369 tests run, so a flaky binary there leaves them unproven. Ask: run `just test-atip` from a clean worktree and bind that result, and decide whether the job needs `-- --test-threads=N`.
